fusions.name: Weighted Fan
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, and each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Draw It Tight
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Mesh Line
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of mesh 6 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Slips Through
fusions.desc: Your damage rises 12% against enemies suffering an affliction.
